ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% high-intensity white background against 40% low-intensity black pigmentation and shadow detail.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity zone at the peduncle junction; extensive black mottling and discrete circular spots distributed across both lobes, with higher density clusters along the trailing edge margins and mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior pixel angle and significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge; several distinct larger notches on the outer margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curvature originating from the median notch and sweeping upward to sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, off-white/yellowish circular pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme distal tips and segments of the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the tips and leading edges; irregular dark pigmentation clusters that disrupt the white base layer.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical distribution of black mottling across the medial surfaces of both lobes.
